name: panoramawatertank-nextgen
description: Panorama Water Tank Monitor — Railway SCADA/HMI Web Application

scripts.build: cd apps/mobile && npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.resolve('dist'); const dest = path.resolve('../../dist'); fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Successfully synced apps/mobile/dist to root dist');"
